label: Bible Study
prompt: Is any sick among you? let him call for the _____ of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verse: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
note: James' instructions for the sick — call the church elders, pray, and anoint with oil.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will _____ in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
verse: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
note: Sing and rejoice, Zion — God is coming to dwell in the midst of thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a _____ of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
verse: All the presidents of the kingdom, the governors, and the princes, the counsellors, and the captains, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a firm decree, that whosoever shall ask a petition of any God or man for thirty days, save of thee, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
note: The trap for Daniel: no petition to any god or man but the king for thirty days — or into the lions' den.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast _____.
verse: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
note: Jacob the heel-grabber gets a new name, Israel, after wrestling God until daybreak.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the _____ shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verse: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
note: Valleys raised, mountains lowered, 'the crooked shall be made straight' — road crews clearing the way for the coming King.
